label: sdc02_0235_chairman_stopper
text: I hope you’re not in a hurry to leave, Champion\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c\nI would very much like to chat a little longer.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]It has been a while, Champion\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_01
text: Hiya, kiddo! Rika’s here, too—at your service![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_02
text: Not gonna lie, I never dreamed we’d be running\ninto you![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_02
text: I see that you are putting your skills to good use\nand living up to your title as a Paldea Champion\r\neven while abroad.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_select_01
text: I’m doing my best!

label: sdc02_0235_select_02
text: That’s what Champions do!

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_03
text: Ha... Indeed. I would expect nothing less from\na talented Trainer such as yourself.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_04
text: Yeah, definitely got talent. Lotsa talent...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_05
text: But not enough to get you off the hook![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_06
text: You went into the Great Crater without the\nLeague’s permission, didn’t you?![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_07
text: Don’t think you’re not gonna get a scolding for\nthat![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_select_03
text: I’m really sorry...

label: sdc02_0235_select_04
text: That’s what Champions...do?

label: sdc02_0235_ground_08
text: Oh sure, NOW you’re sorry—I practically fell out\nof my seat when I heard about where you’d been![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_09
text: What’s that got to do with anything?! You can’t\njust go breaking rules willy-nilly![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_04
text: Calm down, Rika. No harm came to h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer, after all.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_05
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]And besides, we have good reason to believe
that all of Paldea would have been at risk if
Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)] here
hadn’t
ventured
into
Area
Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_10
text: Well, yeah, I mean that’s true, but...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_11
text: Fine. I’ll let you off the hook this one time. You’d\nbetter thank the boss for steppin’ in.[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_06
text: Don’t think poorly of Rika. She’s just worried\nfor you.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_07
text: Now then, Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_08
text: This time, you’ll be heading to Area Zero with\nofficial League permission.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_09
text: Only a handful of people know about the\nincident involving the time machine.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_10
text: However, taking into account the dangers of\nArea Zero, I have elected to inform Ms. Briar\r\nof what happened—obfuscating certain details.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_12
text: Speaking of, Boss... Didn’t you say you had\nsomething to give to that Briar person?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_11
text: ...Yes. Yes, I did. I’d forgotten about that.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_12
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Champion [VAR 0x0100(0000)],
would
you
be
so
kind
as
to
take
this
for
me?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_13
text: What is that, anyway—a TM or something?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_13
text: It is a disk that was sent by an Area Zero\nresearcher to an investor some time ago.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_14
text: I had my investigation team look into it. It is\ncertainly not a TM, nor is it a mere tool for\r\nstoring data.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_15
text: I honestly have no idea as to its true purpose...\nBut I assume it has to do with Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_16
text: I figured that since you’re heading to Area Zero,\nI might as well ask you to investigate the purpose\r\nof this disk while you’re there.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_14
text: While [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she’s there, huh? Did you want h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer to pick\nup some potato salad on the way back, too?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_17
text: I do ask that you return the disk to me if you end\nup not finding a use for it.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_18
text: There is still much we do not know about Area\nZero...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_19
text: I know you’ve already been to its depths, but\nplease exercise some caution while dealing with\r\nthe environment and Pokémon there.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_20
text: As a Champion, it falls on you to protect and\nguide those accompanying you.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_15
text: Wish I could go with you, kiddo, but I’ve got my\nown work to do...[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_ground_16
text: Do your best down there, but don’t push yourself\ntoo hard, y’hear?[VAR 0x0114(0013)]

label: sdc02_0235_chairman_21
text: Now, please excuse us.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: sdc02_0235_brother_01
text: Area Zero, right? C’mon, let’s go. I wanna get\nstarted.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0235_sister_01
text: Kiki’s awful quiet. I hope he’s OK... He was so\nbent out of shape when he lost...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
